reason: The cited evidence shows USR reduces roughness and increases hardness and compressive stress, but provides no quantitative support for the specific 35% hardness increase, Ra 0.05 μm, −685 MPa stress, or 2× wear reduction claimed in the premises.
premises: Surface ultrasonic rolling (USR) can refine grain structure and induce compressive residual stress in TC4
USR can increase surface hardness of TC4 by ~35% (to ~420 HV)
USR can reduce surface roughness of TC4 to Ra ~0.05 μm
USR-induced compressive stress can reach ~−685 MPa
USR can reduce wear volume by a factor of 2 or more under high-contact stress
